limitations: Case 3 is resolved as NOT APPLICABLE to Proofable's current authority path, not demonstrated.
Proofable's dispatch authority reads the LOCAL proof store (getProofsByWallet); it does not query a remote authority/verifier service on this path.

The engine has a modeled fail-closed gateway branch (gatewayReachable=false → GATEWAY_UNREACHABLE → DENY), but that is an engine input, not a live remote dependency, so there is no live outage to exercise here.
A genuine remote-authority-unreachable comparison requires the peer harness with a real remote status source, which is the joint-run item.
